If you want to recover the rocket from this mission, it must land on a droneship.\nA droneship is not required in the following cases:^^^若想回收本次任务的火箭，它必须降落在无人驳船上。\n以下情况无需无人驳船：

<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>1) Missions to <color=#55BBFF>Low Earth Orbit</color>\n2) Missions to <color=#55BBFF>Medium Earth Orbit</color> when less than half of the fairing capacity is used^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>1) 飞往 <color=#55BBFF>近地轨道</color> 的任务\n2) 飞往 <color=#55BBFF>中地轨道</color> 且整流罩容量使用不足一半的任务
The Fairingship is not available. Fairings from this mission will not be recovered.^^^整流罩回收船不可用。本次任务的整流罩将无法回收。
The Fairingship is ready and will attempt to catch the fairings as they descend through Earth’s atmosphere under parachutes.^^^整流罩回收船已就绪，将在整流罩乘降落伞下降、穿越地球大气层时尝试将其接住。
Refuelling will be required in order to reach this destination^^^抵达该目的地需要进行轨道补给

Launch the rocket even if it's empty!^^^即使没有载荷也要发射火箭！

<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>Learn how to land a rocket vertically using only its engine. Reach at least 150 meters, then land gently on the second landing zone.^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>学习如何仅凭发动机让火箭垂直着陆。至少飞到 150 米，然后平稳降落在第二着陆区。
<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>Help your employees etc^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>帮助你的员工等等
<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>Supply astronauts with rotated chicken yessss^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>为宇航员供应旋转鸡肉，耶——
<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>Your company can now apply for a loan of up to $12M^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>你的公司现在可申请最高 $12M 的贷款
<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>CRSP-15 exploded during re-entry on Mars. It was sent to the Rocket Valhalla.</color></size>^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>CRSP-15 在火星再入大气层时发生爆炸。它已被送往“火箭英灵殿”。</color></size>

<size=90%><color=#ffffff99>The most advanced space telescope ever built, designed to study the origins of the universe. It will explore galaxies, stars, and planets, providing valuable insights into their history.^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff99>有史以来最先进的太空望远镜，用于研究宇宙的起源。它将探索星系、恒星与行星，为解读其历史提供宝贵洞见。

<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>A U.S. car company is running a marketing campaign and wants you to launch their prototype electric car into space as a test mission for your new heavy rocket.^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>一家美国汽车公司正在开展营销活动，希望把他们的原型电动车发射到太空，作为你新重型火箭的试验任务。
<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>Transfer window with Mars is now <color=#E74C3C>closed</color>^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>与火星的转移窗口现已<color=#E74C3C>关闭</color>
<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>Red lines must be aligned with the white lines^^^<size=90%><color=#ffffff75>红线必须与白线对齐

"Remember to drink some water as you play the game. It allows your brain to function - and perhaps you won't write a negative review in case of a misunderstanding"^^^“玩游戏时记得喝点水。这能让大脑保持运转——万一产生什么误会，或许你就不会写差评了”
Just Read The Instructions^^^照着说明书来就行
Astronauts are chatting with their families via video call.^^^宇航员正在与家人视频通话。
Astronauts are cleaning and maintaining the station..^^^宇航员正在清洁和维护空间站……
Astronauts are exercising on the treadmill.^^^宇航员正在跑步机上锻炼。
Astronauts are experimenting with zero-gravity cooking.^^^宇航员正在尝试零重力烹饪。
Astronauts are observing Earth from the cupola.^^^宇航员正在穹顶舱眺望地球。

A devastating earthquake has hit a densely populated region, crippling the local infrastructure. Emergency services request your user terminals to coordinate rescue efforts.^^^一场大地震袭击了人口稠密地区，当地基础设施瘫痪。应急部门请求你的用户终端以协调救援行动。
A global pandemic requires a swift and coordinated response. Health organizations need your terminals to track outbreaks and distribute vital information.^^^一场全球大流行病需要迅速且协调的应对。卫生组织需要你的终端来追踪疫情并分发关键信息。
A peaceful country has been invaded, creating a flood of refugees in need of basic services and communication with lost family members.^^^一个和平国家遭到入侵，大量难民流离失所，急需基础服务以及与失散家人的联系。
A region prone to tsunamis lacks an effective early warning system. Local governments ask for your assistance in implementing a satellite-based alert system.^^^一个海啸多发地区缺乏有效的预警系统。当地政府请求你协助建设基于卫星的警报系统。

A remote village, isolated by mountains, seeks Starlink user terminals to connect with the world. They've heard of your work and hope you can assist in bridging their digital divide.^^^一个被大山隔绝的偏远村庄希望获得 Starlink 用户终端以连接世界。他们听说了你的事迹，希望你帮忙弥合数字鸿沟。
A wildlife conservation group needs LinkLink user terminals for the drones to monitor endangered species in remote areas.^^^一个野生动物保护组织需要 LinkLink 用户终端，让无人机监测偏远地区的濒危物种。
An artist working on a remote installation needs user terminals to livestream the artwork's creation to the world.^^^一位在偏远地区创作装置艺术的艺术家需要用户终端，向全世界直播作品的诞生过程。
An initiative to connect the elderly in retirement communities through the internet requests user terminals. They aim to reduce isolation.^^^一个旨在为养老社区老人提供网络连接的公益项目请求用户终端，希望减少他们的孤独感。

Massive wildfires are raging through a national park, and firefighting teams lack the communication tools to effectively combat the blaze. They ask for your drones and terminals.^^^特大野火正在国家公园肆虐，消防队伍缺乏有效控制火情的通信工具。他们请求你的无人机和终端。

Seasonal floods have displaced thousands, destroying homes and cutting off communities. Relief organizations seek your tech to establish temporary communication networks.^^^季节性洪水令数千人流离失所，房屋被毁、社区失联。救援组织寻求你的技术来搭建临时通信网络。
A government agency is offering a lucrative contract to use your satellites for a surveillance program.^^^一家政府机构开出丰厚合同，希望用你的卫星执行监视计划。

An authoritarian regime requests an exclusive contract for your services to establish a tightly controlled communication network. It's a lucrative deal but at what cost?^^^一个威权政权希望独占你的服务，建立高度受控的通信网络。这是一笔诱人的交易——但代价是什么？

Private Military Company (PMC) Contract: "A PMC operating in conflict zones wants to purchase a large supply of your tech for 'logistics and communication'. Their reputation is questionable. Do you fulfill the order?^^^私营军事公司（PMC）合同：“一支活跃于冲突地区的 PMC 想大量采购你的设备用于‘后勤与通信’。他们的名声可不太妙。你要接下这单吗？

An advertising company wants to use your satellites to project ads into the night sky, turning the stars into billboards. It's innovative but highly controversial. Do you light up the sky with ads?^^^一家广告公司想用你的卫星把广告投影到夜空，把星星变成广告牌。这很有创意，但也极具争议。你要点亮这片夜空吗？
A museum dedicated to space exploration history wants to create an exhibit featuring your company. They request a Prime Rocket for the setup.^^^一座航天历史博物馆想为你的公司打造专题展览。他们请求借出一枚中型火箭用于布展。

A local school is hosting a rocket model competition and they're short on funds. They're asking for a donation to help future engineers reach for the stars.^^^一所本地学校正在举办火箭模型比赛，但经费不足。他们请求捐款，帮助未来的工程师们触摸星辰。

A tech university is organizing a space-themed hackathon but lacks sponsors. They're asking for your financial support to nurture future talents in space technology.^^^一所理工大学正在筹办太空主题黑客松，但缺少赞助。他们请求资金支持，以培养太空技术领域的未来人才。
An eccentric scientist claims to be close to a breakthrough in alien communication technology and requests funding.^^^一位古怪科学家自称即将在未知文明通信技术上取得突破，请求资金支持。
you've won a 'Lunar Land Ownership' contest. All they need is a small processing fee to transfer the land rights.^^^你赢得了一场“月球土地所有权”大赛。对方只需一笔小额手续费就能把土地权益过户给你。
